title: Detection of Respiratory Viruses or Housekeeping Genes by qPCR (Taqman)
author: José uiz-Proença Modena
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w8yfhxw

steps.title: Prepare RSV/MPV duplex reaction
steps.instruction: For a 15 µL final volume, combine 3 µL cDNA, 0.5 µL forward primer A (10 pM), 0.5 µL reverse primer A (10 pM), 0.5 µL forward primer B (10 pM), 0.5 µL reverse primer B (10 pM), 0.25 µL probe A (10 pM), and 0.25 µL probe B (10 pM).

steps.title: Prepare Flu/PIV singleplex reaction
steps.instruction: For a 15 µL final volume, add 3 µL cDNA, 0.5 µL forward primer (10 pM), 0.5 µL reverse primer (10 pM), and 0.25 µL probe (10 pM).

steps.title: Prepare BoV/AdV/β‑Actin/RNAseP reaction
steps.instruction: For a 15 µL final volume, add 3 µL cDNA, 0.25 µL forward primer (10 pM), 0.25 µL reverse primer (10 pM), and 0.125 µL probe (10 pM).
